items.title: NVIDIA earnings put its AI chip supply chain to the test
items.author: Ross Prudames
items.highlights: NVIDIA earnings for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 showed revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and 20% on the previous quarter. Data Center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110%, and the company expects fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. The results, published Nov. 17 for the quarter ended Oct. 25, are the first since Jensen Huang resigned as president, chief executive, and board member on Nov. 12.
